name: pt-bench-v2-release
description: A curated benchmark suite released to evaluate Portuguese-language model capabilities across a variety of NLP tasks. It aggregates multiple task types (e.g., classification, QA and generation) in Portuguese to measure understanding, generation quality, and task generalization. The release is intended for comparing models on real-world Portuguese tasks and detecting regressions across versions.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (accuracy / F1 for classification, exact_match/F1 for QA, BLEU/ROUGE for generation/translation)
reputation: A community dataset with particular relevance to Portuguese-language evaluation; moderate niche adoption on Hugging Face and among Portuguese NLP researchers.
